utterances.text: Well, whether it was the following day or two or three days later, I heard that there had been more buses, but I didn't see them. I only saw the ones in front of the municipal building.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Now, you testified that one evening in Bratunac you heard some shooting around the school. Was that before or after that evening or was it that evening?

utterances.speaker: DRAGAN MIRKOVIC
utterances.text: I heard, but I'm not sure whether it was that very evening. I heard about the shooting.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: I'm sorry. You heard about the shooting or you heard the shooting itself?

utterances.speaker: DRAGAN MIRKOVIC
utterances.text: I heard the shooting.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Now, you mentioned that there were some bodies at the Vuk Karadzic school. Who was it that told you about that?

utterances.speaker: DRAGAN MIRKOVIC
utterances.text: I don't think I said that it was at the school, that the bodies were in the school building, but rather around it. I saw several corpses in the schoolyard. I didn't enter the school building, so I couldn't have seen any corpses in the school building.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: If you could just focus on my question, please. Who was it that told you about the bodies at the school?

utterances.speaker: DRAGAN MIRKOVIC
utterances.text: I'm referring to the corpses that I knew that were around the school building, not in the school building. I don't think I've mentioned that at all.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Just to be clear, you said that there were five or six bodies. Do you know where, around which building, they were at?

utterances.speaker: DRAGAN MIRKOVIC
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Which building was it?

utterances.speaker: DRAGAN MIRKOVIC
utterances.text: The Vuk Karadzic school building.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Now, when you say "the Vuk Karadzic school building," we know that there's several buildings there. Which building is it?

utterances.speaker: DRAGAN MIRKOVIC
utterances.text: The school building where the classrooms are. That's what I consider a school building. In addition, they also have a gym hall and the hangar, as it was called at the time. That's separate. But that was in the yard of the school building.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: So that's the main school building with the gym attached to it at the back?

utterances.speaker: DRAGAN MIRKOVIC
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Were the bodies in the front or the back of the school?

utterances.speaker: DRAGAN MIRKOVIC
utterances.text: Facing the municipal building.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: So that was on the street side of the school. Is that correct?

utterances.speaker: DRAGAN MIRKOVIC
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Now, do you recall telling Mr. Ruez who it was who told you to remove bodies from the school?

utterances.speaker: DRAGAN MIRKOVIC
utterances.text: I don't remember.

utterances.speaker: MR. SHIN
utterances.text: If I could please have the -- I'm sorry, the B/C/S transcript of the interview placed before the witness. And if I could ask Your Honours' indulgence just for a moment while I find the specific B/C/S page reference.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Okay, Mr. Mirkovic. If I could please direct you to page 39 of the B/C/S transcript.

utterances.speaker: MR. SHIN
utterances.text: And on the English, Your Honours, that is page 35.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: If you could just please read that page to yourself, Mr. Mirkovic.

utterances.speaker: DRAGAN MIRKOVIC
utterances.text: Page 39?

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE LIU
utterances.text: Well, Mr. Shin, do you have an English version at your hands?

utterances.speaker: MR. SHIN
utterances.text: Yes, I do.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE LIU
utterances.text: Is it possible to put it on the ELMO.

utterances.speaker: MR. SHIN
utterances.text: Yes, please. Could we have the English on the ELMO. Page 35. And page 35. I'll begin from line 3. And you can just follow along, Mr. Mirkovic. Question: "There's a hangar that was in Bratunac town that was used to detain prisoners during the night between the 11th and the 12th -- sorry, the 12th and 13th, where at least around 50 people were killed during the night." I'm sorry. I'll slow down. "At least around 50 people were killed during the night. Was the public utility company requested to dispose all these bodies?" "A. Between the 12th and the 13th?

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Yes. The people from that hangar were evacuated around midnight on the 13th, so during the night between the 13th and the 14th. So probably the disposal of the bodies would have happened probably the 14th.

utterances.speaker: DRAGAN MIRKOVIC
utterances.text: Yes, it was requested. I'm not quite sure about the date. I'm not certain about the date, but it was requested.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Do you know where these bodies were taken to?

utterances.speaker: DRAGAN MIRKOVIC
utterances.text: Actually, they were just asking one truck from us and the people to load the bodies on the truck, but where the bodies were taken, I didn't know.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Do you know who made this request?

utterances.speaker: DRAGAN MIRKOVIC
utterances.text: Someone from the army asked, but who precisely I wouldn't know." Mr. Mirkovic, does that help remind you who it was who asked this?

utterances.speaker: DRAGAN MIRKOVIC
utterances.text: This is how it was, but I don't know who it was who asked it.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Do you remember where you were when the request was made of you?

utterances.speaker: DRAGAN MIRKOVIC
utterances.text: In my office.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Did someone come see you in person, this someone from the army, or was it a telephone call? How did you hear the request?

utterances.speaker: DRAGAN MIRKOVIC
utterances.text: The request came by telephone.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: And you didn't ask who was it who was making the call?

utterances.speaker: DRAGAN MIRKOVIC
utterances.text: No. If I had asked, I would probably know now who it was who called me.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Does the transcript of your interview, that portion, does it help remind you whether there were more than five or six bodies at the Vuk Karadzic school?

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: Your Honour, I think he mischaracterises his earlier testimony. He -- the gentleman indicated that he saw four or five or five or six bodies outside. He indicated what he learned thereafter from others. So I think it's a slight mischaracterisation of what he testified to on direct.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE LIU
utterances.text: Yes, I think so. I think there is a little nuance there.

utterances.speaker: MR. SHIN
utterances.text: Perhaps I could just put a simple question to Mr. Mirkovic.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Mr. Mirkovic, how many bodies were taken from the Vuk Karadzic school?

utterances.speaker: DRAGAN MIRKOVIC
utterances.text: I said just a little while ago that I saw five or six bodies. According to what the driver said who took the bodies away, he said there were more. Whether it was 50, 60, or 40, I can't be sure.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Did you find out that there were more? You were told that there may be more, but did you in fact find out that there were, in fact, more?

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: Again, Your Honour, more than what? Five or six or 50, 60, or 40? The gentleman has -- and I don't mean to be disruptive, but he needs to be fair to the witness. He's indicated what he learned. He indicated that he did not go there personally inside the school to see it. He's testified as to what he saw and what he learned. And I think the question that is being posed is vague. So if he could be more precise in his questioning, perhaps we could end the cross a little bit earlier.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE LIU
utterances.text: I agree with you. Maybe you could rephrase your question.

utterances.speaker: MR. SHIN
utterances.text: I would be happy to clarify that.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Mr. Mirkovic, did you find out at any point that there were more -- did you find out for a fact that there were more than five or six bodies at the Vuk Karadzic school?

utterances.speaker: DRAGAN MIRKOVIC
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Thank you. Now, as far as you can recall, were there any other bodies in Bratunac town that the public utilities company had to pick up that night or the night after or the night before?

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: Again, Your Honour, I don't mean to be disruptive. He never indicated that he picked up any bodies at night. Now we're injecting -- you know -- it's -- it may seem innocuous, but I think if it was posed differently, I wouldn't object. If he picked up any bodies in Bratunac any time of day, fine. But that night, suggesting he was picking up bodies at night, hence suggesting some kind of a clandestine operation going on.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE LIU
utterances.text: Well, Mr. Karnavas, I don't think there's any problem in this question. The witness could answer that question according to what he saw and what he heard. There's no problem with it.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: It was the night part that got me excited.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE LIU
utterances.text: I understand that. I understand. You may proceed, Mr. Shin.

utterances.speaker: MR. SHIN
utterances.text: Thank you, Mr. President.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Mr. Mirkovic, if you could answer the question, please.

utterances.speaker: DRAGAN MIRKOVIC
utterances.text: Would you please repeat your question.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: I'll put it. I'll put the question very broadly. The day that -- either the day or night that these bodies from the Vuk Karadzic school were picked up, either that day or night or the day before or the day after, did the public utilities pick up any other bodies?

utterances.speaker: DRAGAN MIRKOVIC
utterances.text: I don't remember.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Now, you've indicated that you know Mr. Blagojevic. Do you know Mr. Nikolic, Momir Nikolic?

utterances.speaker: DRAGAN MIRKOVIC
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: How long have you known him?

utterances.speaker: DRAGAN MIRKOVIC
utterances.text: 30 or 35 years.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: How would you characterise your relations with him? Is he a friend of yours?

utterances.speaker: DRAGAN MIRKOVIC
utterances.text: We are comrades. We socialised. Whether he was a friend or no, that's a broad term. But we did socialise and we considered each other friends.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Now, at no point in your testimony today have you indicated that you spoke or spoke to or saw Mr. Nikolic in the course of asanacija work that you described today. Is that correct?

utterances.speaker: DRAGAN MIRKOVIC
utterances.text: I couldn't say that. I saw him or talked to him, because I didn't see him at all during those days.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Similarly nor in your interview did you say anything about speaking to or seeing Mr. Nikolic during the course of the asanacija -- the asanacija in Glogova, Kravica, or Bratunac?

utterances.speaker: DRAGAN MIRKOVIC
utterances.text: I repeat, I did not talk to Mr. Nikolic about these matters at all because I did not see him at all in that period, in those days.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Do you know Mr. Miroslav Deronjic?

utterances.speaker: DRAGAN MIRKOVIC
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: How long have you known him?

utterances.speaker: DRAGAN MIRKOVIC
utterances.text: 30 or 35 years, or maybe longer.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Would you also consider him a friend?

utterances.speaker: DRAGAN MIRKOVIC
utterances.text: We were friends, comrades.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Just one final question. You mentioned that there were bodies at Konjevic Polje. How many bodies were there?

utterances.speaker: DRAGAN MIRKOVIC
utterances.text: There were 10 or 15 bodies.

utterances.speaker: MR. SHIN
utterances.text: Thank you. No further questions, Your Honour.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE LIU
utterances.text: Thank you. Any re-direct?

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: Yes, just a couple of points. Re-examined by Mr. Karnavas:

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: A couple of questions. You were asked a question about Miroslav Deronjic, presumably because you didn't see him during those days. Now, how long were you the director of the Rad company, utility company, the managing director?

utterances.speaker: DRAGAN MIRKOVIC
utterances.text: For a little less than 16 years.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: And as I understand it, you were fired from that position. Correct?

utterances.speaker: DRAGAN MIRKOVIC
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: And as I understand it, it was Miroslav Deronjic that fired you or had you released from that position. Correct?

utterances.speaker: DRAGAN MIRKOVIC
utterances.text: Mr. Deronjic was one of the participants together with the people who then took power from the Radical Party.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Just briefly tell us, because we may go into motive, just tell us why was it that Deronjic was one of the participants in getting you fired from your position that you held as managing director a little bit less than 16 years.

utterances.speaker: DRAGAN MIRKOVIC
utterances.text: In the Bratunac municipality, the SDS was in power up to those elections. Then the Radicals won the elections and the companies were distributed among them. So that Miroslav Deronjic sold the utilities company and me, even though I had been in the SDS with him. They wanted various concessions. These new people that took power such as Mladen Simic, Milivoj Radanovic, also known as Mungos. I didn't want to be a puppet, as the managing director and do whatever they wanted, so I came into conflict with them and that is why I was fired later on.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Okay. So obviously you have no motive to cover him -- cover up Deronjic. If you had seen him, you would tell us whether he was at the SDS office when you went there on those two occasions. Correct?

utterances.speaker: DRAGAN MIRKOVIC
utterances.text: Of course I would say that.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: One last area. You were asked on cross about going to the Kravica warehouse, the agricultural warehouse. And you were asked the time of day. Now, I believe you said it was in the afternoon. I want you to think back. Could you please tell us. Was it in the morning, noon, or afternoon? What is -- what was the time to the best of your recollection, if you know, if you can tell us.

utterances.speaker: DRAGAN MIRKOVIC
utterances.text: Around noon. What time it was exactly, I wouldn't know, but it was sometime around noon.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Okay. Thank you very much, sir. I have no further questions.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE LIU
utterances.text: Thank you. Well, at this stage, are there any documents to tender?

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: No, Mr. President.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE LIU
utterances.text: Mr. Shin?

utterances.speaker: MR. SHIN
utterances.text: No, Mr. President.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE LIU
utterances.text: Thank you. Well, thank you, Witness, for coming to The Hague to give your evidence. The usher will show you out of the room and we wish you a pleasant journey back home. You may go now.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Thank you. May I ask a question, please, Your Honours.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE LIU
utterances.text: Yes, please.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Interpretation] If possible, if you will allow me to shake hands with Mr. Blagojevic.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE LIU
utterances.text: Well, I'm afraid that is not allowed. I'm sorry for that.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Very well.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE LIU
utterances.text: Well, we still have about an hour left. Mr. Karnavas, are you going to call your next witness or we stop here?

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: Your Honour, had I known that you wanted me to have witnesses back to back, I could have probably had the next witness available. I didn't provide for that, I apologise. So the answer is we could break and if you want I can in the future have somebody in the backdrop just in case to fill in the time. I certainly don't object to going all the way to the last minute, since I've been given a very short period of time to put my case together.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE LIU
utterances.text: Well, we did not expect this proceeding so smoothly. So we finish a bit ahead of the schedule. And the frankly speaking, we are satisfied with the pace of the proceedings, which is one witness, one day. This is our original plan. And we sit over time for two days. I think we should make up for those two days. And before the hearing is adjourned, could you please brief us about the tomorrow's witness? For instance, whether there's any protective measures for this witness, or are you going to furnish us with some proofing notes?

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: Well, I am unaware of as of this moment that any protective measures will be needed. As for the proofing notes, proofing notes will be provided but not today, not right now. I will have them. I will have them hopefully by first thing in the morning, since we're breaking a little early today. We're just -- the witnesses are coming in rather late, and we're working as fast as we can to meet with them as early as possible to provide the proofing notes. But just to make sure that Your Honours understand what we're also doing, as soon as we -- before we put the notes down on the paper we do make a courtesy call and give the Prosecutor notice of anything unusual so they can have as much time as possible to prepare. So we're doing our best.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE LIU
utterances.text: Well, I'm a little bit disappointed with your answer. Because you could not tell us tomorrow seeing that this witness or the voice distortion, because we'd need some technical preparations for that. And as for the proofing notes, well, we hope we could get it as early as possible.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: Yes, Your Honour. As I said as of now I don't anticipate. But one can change their mind. And so being a lawyer I don't want to be committed to a particular answer. So I'm giving myself a little bit of room just in case the witness changes their mind.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE LIU
utterances.text: Thank you. And this hearing is adjourned.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE LIU
